releases.notes:
Install the JAR that matches your Minecraft version, **26.2** or **26.3**. If you're upgrading from a 1.0.4 prerelease, download the stable JAR here and replace the old one. Your saved settings carry over.

### New settings menu

- `/zpbw` opens the new ClickGUI and `/zpbw help` lists the commands. The menu remembers its last tab and keeps a consistent size across Minecraft GUI scales.
- Adjust Blinkwarp, chain maximum, timeout, and NoSneakDelay. **Reset to Optimized Defaults** applies only to Blinkwarp and sets it on, chain maximum to 3, timeout to 8 ticks, and Smooth Landings off. Help badges explain the chain limit and suggest a timeout based on ping.
- **Smooth Landings (Visual)** softens the small vertical camera hop. It is off by default.
- General adds chat controls, GitHub and issue links, and an option to pause prediction in restricted puzzles, boss phases, and other areas. The location safeguard is enabled by default.

### Overlay and sounds

- Preview the next Etherwarp landing while a previous warp awaits confirmation. Show Always also previews while holding an eligible item without sneaking.
- Customize fill, outline, opacity, and shape with the color picker and hex entry. With Depth off, the overlay draws above ordinary waypoints. Depth keeps terrain occlusion.
- Search and preview Minecraft sounds, adjust volume and pitch, and choose whether the sound plays on Blinkwarp or on the server's Etherwarp cue. **Play Sound on Failed Guesses** can replace a matching server cue even when Blinkwarp did not play a local sound.

### Recovery and diagnostics

- **Server Lag Compensation (Experimental)** is enabled by default, with saved off choices preserved. It attempts to reduce kicks during server stalls by dropping stale held movement and letting normal movement and genuine teleport replies continue.
- After a failed prediction, Blinkwarp can resume once the genuine teleport and the next native input boundary complete. Continued clicks no longer restart the old recovery wait.
- **Copy debug logs** and `/zpbw logs` include more context for distinct failures, queued actions, and recovery. Chat can be reduced or disabled without losing diagnostic reports. If copying fails, logs go to the console.
- Update notices link to the matching Minecraft download and mark prereleases as optional.

**Known issues:** ZPBW still needs work, so take this release with a grain of salt. Rapid chained Etherwarps can still produce rare snapbacks. The experimental stall fix was tested locally, and the exact remote kick remains unverified. If you hit either issue, run `/zpbw logs` soon afterward and attach the report to a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/hawkzlol/zpbw/issues).

**Chore:** We're still looking to improve the prediction engine. If you can help make a substantial improvement, contact **zhxwks** on Discord (message request preferred).

releases.notes:
Supports **Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3** with separate native Fabric JARs. Install only the artifact matching your Minecraft version; keep your config and remove the old ZPBW JAR.

### Changes
- Native 26.3 support with shared behavior and version-specific response/input handling.
- `/zpbw chainmax [value]`: configurable overlap, 1–5, default 5; pending work is preserved.
- More accurate grazing-edge prediction and better mismatch diagnostics.
- Automatic same-connection recovery, improved timeout grace and safer chaining/native position reminders.
- Cleaner queued-action/mining handling, disconnect cleanup, clipboard support and console log fallback.
- Update notices choose the matching native JAR.

### Requirements
Java 25 and Fabric Language Kotlin 1.13.13+kotlin.2.4.10 or newer, plus:
- **26.2:** Fabric Loader ≥0.19.3; Fabric API ≥0.155.2+26.2.
- **26.3:** Fabric Loader ≥0.19.5; Fabric API ≥0.165.0+26.3.

### Verification and limitations
392 shared tests passed on each native version. The latest scoped lab checks include 24 exact-destination motion/sneak casts and native mismatch recovery on both versions, with zero Trips in those checks.

**Known issue:** an intermittent falling 1.414-block prediction discrepancy remains under investigation. Instant camera-turn/block-use timing and remote server/model limitations also remain; see the [validation notes](https://github.com/hawkzlol/zpbw/blob/v1.0.3/docs/validation-1.0.3.md). Export `/zpbw logs` immediately after a problem and review its coordinates/mod versions before sharing.

# ZPBW 1.0.2

For Minecraft Java 26.2 · Fabric · Java 25

## Changes

- **Smoother chaining:** reuse a prediction slot as each genuine teleport confirms, without waiting for the entire chain to drain. Up to five additional warp clicks can queue when all five prediction slots are occupied.
- **NoSneakDelay input fix:** use current movement, jump and sprint keys at the next uncommitted native sample instead of replaying an older deferred snapshot. Early sneak, brief taps and immediate sneak-use remain supported.
- **Stronger recovery:** after a failed chain, wait for remaining genuine teleports before resuming dependent movement and actions. Preserve real knockback/explosion impulses when no teleport supersedes them.
- Keep queued interactions, native teleport acknowledgements and session/ownership cleanup ordered throughout recovery.

## Notes

- Recovery after a failure can briefly pause movement and queued actions. High latency or bursts of nonzero server Pings can still trigger timeouts.
- An input already sent by NoSneakDelay must remain committed through its first natural sample; this update removes stale replay, not that first-sample delay.
- 237 automated tests pass. The latest isolated lab matrices completed 114 windows at 25–300 ms with no Simulation flags or setbacks; DuplicateRotPlace also reproduced with both features disabled. These results do not guarantee anticheat compatibility or cover every Hypixel/modpack combination. Earlier baseline attribute synchronization and delayed-server model limitations are documented in the [validation notes](https://github.com/hawkzlol/zpbw/blob/v1.0.2/docs/validation-1.0.2.md).

Install `zpbw-1.0.2.jar` and remove the previous ZPBW JAR. Fabric API and Fabric Language Kotlin are required. Restart Minecraft after replacing the mod.

If something goes wrong, run `/zpbw logs` before closing Minecraft and include the copied report in a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/hawkzlol/zpbw/issues).

# ZPBW 1.0.1 — Minecraft 26.2

## Fixes

### Mining and interactions

- Keep queued mining and its swing together after warp confirmation, with physics using the updated block state.
- Cancel mining against changed or missing blocks and recheck the target before replay.
- Prevent held mining from accumulating multiple progress updates in one tick; clear queued mining on world/connection changes.

### Prediction and recovery

- Fix first-warp predictions when sneak was pressed but had not yet been sent to the server. NoSneakDelay remains supported.
- Discard obsolete movement/input ticks after a failed prediction while preserving inventory synchronization.
- Refresh the interaction target after rollback and restore input, sprint and hotbar tracking when buffered actions are cancelled.
- Add dispatched use angles and movement context to `/zpbw logs` for diagnosing airborne prediction mismatches.

### Standalone SkyBlock detection

- Remove the optional Blackwell lookup and developer override dependency.
- Read full sidebar text, tab headers/footers and rendered player names directly from Minecraft.
- Handle formatted text and Unicode spacing; ignore empty or decorative area labels.

## Verification and remaining limits

- 202 automated mod tests pass. Gameplay fixes were exercised in the owned Grim lab at 25–300 ms latency, including mining, interactions, recovery, jumps and Jump Boost V.
- The new detector passed automated checks and mapping verification; a minimal-client/live SkyBlock runtime check has not been completed.
- Five-warp chaining still pauses new dispatch after the first confirmation until the remaining chain settles. Timeout still counts nonzero server Ping packets; bursts can exhaust its budget. General airborne prediction mismatches remain under investigation.

## Installation

Requires Minecraft 26.2, Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.3+, Fabric API and Fabric Language Kotlin. No other SkyBlock mod is required.

Replace the older ZPBW JAR with `zpbw-1.0.1.jar` and restart Minecraft. Existing settings are preserved. Run `/zpbw logs` after a problem to collect a troubleshooting report.

# ZPBW 1.0.0 — Minecraft 26.2

Zero Ping Blinkwarp predicts supported etherwarp destinations locally and keeps camera and movement responsive while waiting for the real server teleport. Dependent actions stay in order until confirmation.

## Installation

Requires Minecraft Java 26.2, Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer, Fabric API and Fabric Language Kotlin.

Download `zpbw-1.0.0.jar`, remove any older standalone ZPBW JAR from your `mods` folder, and install this one. Existing settings are preserved. Restart Minecraft after replacing the JAR.

## Getting started

- Run `/zpbw` for the command list and `/zpbw on` to enable prediction.
- `/zpbw nsd` toggles NoSneakDelay; both features default to off on a fresh installation.
- `/zpbw timeout <ticks>` sets the confirmation timeout, clamped to 2–20 server Ping packets (default 20).
- `/zpbw logs` copies session diagnostics for a [bug report](https://github.com/hawkzlol/zpbw/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- Newer stable releases are checked once per client session; notifications appear after joining SkyBlock. No automatic downloads or installation.

## Notes

Up to five unconfirmed warps can overlap. After the first confirmation, new dispatch briefly waits for the rest of that chain to settle. Prediction uses the world visible to your client and can differ from the server. Queued interactions still depend on server confirmation; network latency itself remains.

The release passes 174 standalone tests and Windows/Linux CI. Earlier local lab testing covered latency, chains, interactions and recovery; it does not establish every live-server/mod combination or guarantee freedom from bans.

The attached SHA-256 file identifies the release JAR. Review copied diagnostics before sharing: they include positions, timings and mod versions.
